description: This file contains Redux reducer functions and related utilities for managing post entities, including handling post metadata, replies, thread relationships, reactions, acknowledgements, open graph data, message history, and view limits within the Mattermost application.

methods.name: removeUnneededMetadata
methods.description: Removes unnecessary metadata fields from a post object, such as emojis, files, reactions, acknowledgements, and cleans up embed data to optimize storage.

methods.name: nextPostsReplies
methods.description: Tracks reply counts for posts, updating state based on received post actions, deletions, and user logout.

methods.name: removePostsAndEmbedsForChannels
methods.description: Removes posts and permalink embeds associated with specified channel IDs from the posts state.

methods.name: handlePosts
methods.description: Main reducer function that manages the collection of posts, handling creation, updates, deletions, and related post relationships.

methods.name: handlePostReceived
methods.description: Processes an individual post received, updating the store with new or modified post data, handling metadata, deletions, and nested permalinks.

methods.name: handlePendingPosts
methods.description: Manages the list of pending post IDs during post creation transitions.

methods.name: postsInChannel
methods.description: Maintains the ordered list of posts per channel, handling new posts, updates, and deletions within channel post lists.

methods.name: removeNonRecentEmptyPostBlocks
methods.description: Filters out empty or non-recent post blocks from post block arrays.

methods.name: mergePostBlocks
methods.description: Merges overlapping or adjacent post blocks into a unified ordered block list.

methods.name: mergePostOrder
methods.description: Combines two post ID arrays into a sorted, duplicate-free order based on creation timestamps.

methods.name: postsInThread
methods.description: Tracks comments within a thread, updating the list of comment IDs for each root post.

methods.name: postEditHistory
methods.description: Stores the edit history of posts.

methods.name: currentFocusedPostId
methods.description: Tracks the ID of the currently focused post, such as in permalink view.

methods.name: reactions
methods.description: Stores emoji reactions associated with posts, updating on reaction add or delete.

methods.name: openGraph
methods.description: Stores OpenGraph metadata for link previews within posts.

methods.name: storeReactionsForPost
methods.description: Extracts and stores reactions from a post’s metadata.

methods.name: storeAcknowledgementsForPost
methods.description: Extracts and stores acknowledgements from a post’s metadata.

methods.name: storeOpenGraphForPost
methods.description: Extracts and stores OpenGraph embed data from a post’s metadata.
